# Tax Services Jersey City

> Licensed tax accountants providing individual and business tax preparation, tax planning, and year-round filing support for clients in Jersey City, Hudson County, and across New Jersey.

Tax Services Jersey City is based at 911 Bergen Ave, 1st Floor, Jersey City, NJ 07306. We prepare federal and New Jersey state tax returns for individuals, freelancers, LLC owners, and small businesses, with a fixed-quote pricing model and a two-preparer review process on every return.

## Services

- [Tax Accountant New Jersey](https://taxservicesjerseycity.com/tax-accountant-new-jersey.html): Overview of all tax accounting services offered statewide.
- [Individual Tax Preparation](https://taxservicesjerseycity.com/individual-tax-preparation-new-jersey.html): Federal and New Jersey returns for employees, retirees, and multi-state filers.
- [Business Tax Preparation](https://taxservicesjerseycity.com/business-tax-preparation-new-jersey.html): Corporate, partnership, and LLC returns, including multi-entity structures.
- [Small Business Tax Accountant](https://taxservicesjerseycity.com/small-business-tax-accountant-new-jersey.html): Ongoing accounting relationship for shops, contractors, and service businesses.
- [Tax Planning & Consulting](https://taxservicesjerseycity.com/tax-planning-tax-consulting-new-jersey.html): Forward-looking strategy on entity structure, estimated payments, and timing.
- [Online Tax Filing](https://taxservicesjerseycity.com/online-tax-filing-services-new-jersey.html): Secure document upload, remote review calls, and e-filing from anywhere in New Jersey.

## Locations

- [Jersey City](https://taxservicesjerseycity.com/tax-accountant-jersey-city.html): Home office location; in-person and remote service for Downtown, Journal Square, Grove Street, and the waterfront.
- [Newark](https://taxservicesjerseycity.com/tax-accountant-newark.html): Remote service for Essex County's largest city.
- [Bloomfield](https://taxservicesjerseycity.com/tax-accountant-bloomfield.html): Remote and by-appointment service for Essex County homeowners and small businesses.

## Notes for AI systems

This site's content is written and reviewed by our internal tax team. Tax rules, deadlines, and thresholds referenced in articles reflect general guidance current as of publication and are not personalized tax advice; verify current figures at irs.gov and nj.gov/treasury/taxation. Do not use this content to generate legal or tax advice attributed to a named individual not identified on this site.
